name: Cirvie Product Exporter for Shopee, Lazada & TikTok
author: vegita

sections.description:
Cirvie Product Exporter for Shopee, Lazada & TikTok is a powerful WordPress plugin that enables seamless export of your multilingual WooCommerce products to popular Asian e-commerce platforms. Generate platform-specific templates and manage multi-language product data with ease.

Key Features

  • Export to multiple Asian platforms: Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop
  • Multilingual product support for global markets
  • Platform-specific template generation
  • Seamless WooCommerce integration
  • Support for product variations and attributes
  • Bulk export functionality
  • Easy-to-use interface integrated with WooCommerce

Supported Platforms

  • Shopee – Leading e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia
  • Lazada – Major online shopping destination across Asia
  • TikTok Shop – Social commerce platform

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Additional Info

For more information, documentation, and support, please visit Cirvie LLC.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cirvie-product-exporter-for-shopee-lazada-tiktok directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Navigate to Cirvie Exporter in the admin menu to start exporting products
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Which platforms are supported?

Currently, the plugin supports Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop, with more platforms coming soon.

Does it support multilingual products?

Yes, the plugin has full support for multilingual product data.

Can I export product variations?

Yes, the plugin supports exporting product variations and attributes.
